newsitem.title: USA: MFRI Thermal Care acquisition effective.
newsitem.headline: MFRI Thermal Care acquisition effective.

text.p: MFRI Inc said effective Tuesday it acquired the Thermal Care business and certain assets and liabilities of Midwesco Inc, as part of Midwesco's merger into MFRI.

Before the consummation of the merger, other Midwesco assets and liabilities became part of a newly organized Midwesco subsidiary, the company said. These shares of capital stock were distributed to Midwesco shareholders, it said.
Thermal Care engineers, designs and makes industrial water cooling equipment. In the year ended January 31, 1996, it had net sales of about $20 million, the company said.

MFRI makes and sells filter bags for use in industrial air polltion control systems and designs and makes specialty piping systems, leak detection and location systems and industrial and water cooling equipment.
